say:1:1423375001:1.text: Wow, Miss Orlana really brought Sheena back! That's amazing!
say:1:1423375001:1.source_cn: 唔哇，老师竟然把希娜带回来了，老师真厉害！

say:2:1423375002:1.text: But Sheena, I thought you said you weren't coming. What changed?
say:2:1423375002:1.source_cn: 希娜，你不是说不来上课嘛，怎么现在又过来了？

say:3:1423375003:1.text: Jules, zip it for once, will you?
say:3:1423375003:1.source_cn: 朱尔，你少说几句没人拿你当哑巴！

say:5:1423375004:1.text: Settle down, everyone. Now that we're all here, time for our first lesson to begin.
say:5:1423375004:1.source_cn: 孩子们，安静啦，我们的大家庭人终于齐了，老师要正式开讲...

say:6:1423375005:1.source_cn: 第一堂课的开头，老师想给你们讲一个故事。

say:10:1423375007:1.text: Once upon a time, there was a child who lived on the edge of a forest.
say:10:1423375007:1.source_cn: 从前从前，在森林的边缘住着一个孩子。

say:11:1423375008:1.text: Every day, she cleared weeds from the grassy field. She often wondered what lay deeper inside the forest, but never dared to go in.
say:11:1423375008:1.source_cn: 这个孩子每天的生活就是清理草坪上的野草，她每天在森林边...

say:13:1423375009:1.text: That's silly! What's there to be scared of in a forest?
say:13:1423375009:1.source_cn: 真奇怪，森林里面有什么好怕的，她竟然不敢进去。

say:15:1423375010:1.text: No one ever told her it was okay to enter the forest. They only told her it was dangerous.
say:15:1423375010:1.source_cn: 因为从来没有人告诉她，森林是可以踏入的。他们只告诉她，...

say:16:1423375011:1.text: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."
say:16:1423375011:1.source_cn: 直到有一天，来了一位好心的魔法师，魔法师问她，你既然想...
say:16:1423375011:1.male: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."
say:16:1423375011:1.female: Then one day, a kind mage came by and said, "If you're curious about what's inside the forest, why not go find out? I can go with you."

say:17:1423375012:1.text: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.
say:17:1423375012:1.source_cn: 于是魔法师陪她走入了森林。她发现森林里虽然有野兽，但是...
say:17:1423375012:1.male: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.
say:17:1423375012:1.female: So the mage went with her into the forest. There were wild beasts, sure, but there were also sprites. She became friends with the mage.

say:19:1423375013:1.text: This story's starting to sound familiar...

say:21:1423375014:1.text: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.
say:21:1423375014:1.source_cn: 魔法师和精灵教会了她在森林里生存的办法，她发现，原来靠...
say:21:1423375014:1.male: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.
say:21:1423375014:1.female: The mage and the sprites taught her how to survive in the forest. And slowly, she realized she didn't need to be afraid of the forest anymore.

say:22:1423375015:1.text: So what now? Should she stay on the grassy field, or start a life in the forest? She still wasn't sure where she belonged.
say:22:1423375015:1.source_cn: 可接下来要去哪呢？要继续待在草坪上吗？还是进入森林生活...

say:23:1423375016:1.text: Then one day, she saw something beautiful: The sprites were weaving a huge net from vines—a net that could catch dreams.
say:23:1423375016:1.source_cn: 偶然间，她发现精灵们在用藤蔓编织一种巨大的网，这种网可...

say:25:1423375017:1.text: A net that catches dreams? That sounds so magical!
say:25:1423375017:1.source_cn: 捕捉梦境的网……听起来就好漂亮！

say:27:1423375018:1.text: She thought so too! She couldn't look away. Right then, she realized that this was exactly what she wanted to do. So she picked up some vines and started to weave.
say:27:1423375018:1.source_cn: 她也这么觉得！她被那种巨大美丽的网彻底迷住了，她想，原...

say:28:1423375019:1.text: And guess what? Those hands that were so used to pulling weeds turned out to be surprisingly good at weaving vines.
say:28:1423375019:1.source_cn: 你猜怎么着？她那双清理惯野草的手，编织起藤蔓来反而异常...

say:29:1423375020:1.text: In the end, one less child played on the grassy field, and one more dream-weaver walked the forest.
say:29:1423375020:1.source_cn: 最后的最后，草坪上少了一个孩子，森林里却多了一个编织捕...

say:30:1423375021:1.text: That's the end of the story. Now, if you could be anyone from this story, who would you want to be?
say:30:1423375021:1.source_cn: 这个故事讲完啦。孩子们，告诉我，你们最想成为这个故事里...

say:32:1423375022:1.text: I want to be the kid! I want to meet the mage and the sprites too!
say:32:1423375022:1.source_cn: 我要成为这个孩子！我也要遇见魔法师和精灵！

say:33:1423375023:1.text: Me too! I want to make that dream net!
say:33:1423375023:1.source_cn: 还有我！我要去织捕梦网！

say:34:1423375024:1.text: I think I'd like to be the mage. Or maybe one of the sprites. Without them, the child might never have found the courage to enter the forest.
say:34:1423375024:1.source_cn: 老师想成为魔法师和精灵哦。你们想，没有魔法师的话，这个...

say:35:1423375025:1.text: And without them, she never would've learned how to survive or make the dream net.
say:35:1423375025:1.source_cn: 没有魔法师和精灵，孩子也不会学到在森林里生存和编织捕梦...

say:36:1423375026:1.text: It was thanks to the mage and the sprites that she found her true calling. And I hope I can do the same for all of you...
say:36:1423375026:1.source_cn: 因为有了魔法师和精灵，她才能找到自己真正想做的事。老师...

narration:37:1423375027:0.text: Orlana's story has the kids completely hooked. And just like that, their first lesson comes to a perfect conclusion.
narration:37:1423375027:0.source_cn: 欧罗娜的故事牢牢吸引了孩子们的注意力，属于孩子们的第一...
